'''Vandorn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the rank as [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. Like most members of the Empire, he discriminated against other species, especially the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] and their beliefs and he sought to take advantage of them by tasking strong fighters to defeat a [[Ssevrek|leader]] of Trandoshan prisoners on the planet and use them as slaves. After the Trandoshans were defeated, the fighters enslaved and collared the Trandoshan prisoners.<ref name="TOR" />
